pages.text: There are a few blocks that can be broken down for spirits that you won't see in JEI.$(br2)Nether portals (the purple portal blocks, not the obsidian) yield Nether spirits.$(br2)Fire blocks yield fire spirits.$(br2)Water source blocks yield water spirits.

There's also a special way to get War spirits: every point of damage dealt by a hallowed weapon will put a War spirit in that weapon.$(br2)With some clever setup and a $(l:otherverse:items/spawn_altar)spawn altar$(), this can make for a self-contained mob farm.

If you're using diagrams to smelt an item, they will only smelt the item by one step (i.e. cobblestone into stone, but not into smooth stone) $(italic)unless$() the target item is also influenced by a furnace.
